scripts.build: node -e "const fs=require('fs'),cp=require('child_process'); if(fs.existsSync('frontend')){ cp.execSync('cd frontend && npm install && npm run build', {stdio:'inherit'}); if(!fs.existsSync('dist')) fs.cpSync('frontend/dist', 'dist', {recursive:true}); } else { cp.execSync('npm run build', {stdio:'inherit'}); }"
